uptoSettlementProof.note: The transfer moved the ACTUAL (1000000), not the signed MAXIMUM (1500000). That disagreement is the upto scheme: /verify carried the maximum and /settle carried the actual.

settlementCost.gasCaveat: The facilitator signer was the payer itself, so the sender account and its balance slot were already warm. This is a mild UNDER-estimate of a settlement sent by a distinct facilitator, on the order of one cold-account access (~2600 gas).

calldataObservation.note: x402-rs routed to settle (ff11e7b4, 14 words), not settleWithPermit (0x016c1748, 19 words). Every word-level gate the local adapter's decoder applies (tools/local-x402-adapter/src/main.rs:2101-2178) was re-applied to the mined calldata and passed.

settleTimingObservation.settleErrorMessage: transaction was not confirmed within the timeout
settleTimingObservation.note: POST /settle DOES block past the point where the receipt exists -- it held for 5113ms while the receipt was readable at 2537ms. But the pinned image still returned HTTP 500 with an EMPTY transaction hash, having failed to observe a receipt that had been available for 2.576s. The settlement itself succeeded on chain. A caller trusting the /settle response alone would report a successful, mined, fee-paid payment as a failure, with no transaction hash to recover from.

replayObservation.note: The replayed authorization reverted during eth_estimateGas and was never broadcast. Replay protection is proven by the consumed Permit2 nonce bit, not merely by the error: an UnauthorizedFacilitator revert (0x0f6fae87) would instead have meant the harness sent from the wrong address.

verification.method: One real upto settlement was driven through the pinned x402-rs facilitator against the live GIWA Sepolia RPC. Timing was measured by an independent chain observer that started before the request was sent and scanned blocks forward from a baseline, so broadcast, mined and receipt-visible timestamps are established without reference to the /settle response. Gas and calldata were read back from the mined transaction through raw JSON-RPC and normalized to decimal from hex.
verification.budgetNote: Exactly one transaction was broadcast. No facilitator funding transfer was needed because the payer served as the facilitator signer, and the replay never reached the chain.

scope: Test-only upto settlement evidence on a test token with an open faucet. This closes the on-chain half of gate G1 steps 4-6. It does NOT clear the pinned facilitator for a synchronous paid route: the /settle receipt-confirmation defect recorded in settleTimingObservation is unresolved, and the gateway's own 5s per-call ceiling (crates/gateway/src/x402.rs:29) leaves no headroom to simply raise receipt_timeout_secs.
